items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever see John Shilton's Who's Who? [INTERVIEWEE] I think I have, could have.

ctx.x: Okay. All right, so you came to New York, you enlarged your personnel further -- well no, you "enlarged his personnel further and came to New York. And you made your first recording session for Decca in '37." I just want to stop with this here, because I want to pick up on John
" Shilton's Who's Who and see how it mentions. You know John Shilton (PHONETIC)?
